Component(dsl: 1, id: "test/home", name: "home", kind: Kind.section, description: "Golden case",
  
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: Column(children: [Card(title: "Hi", onPick: ShowMessage(message: "x")), Broken(), Card(variant: "big")]))])

componentSources.Card:
Component(dsl: 1, id: "custom/card", name: "Card", kind: Kind.section, description: "Card",
      options: [StringOption(name: "title", label: "Title", maxLength: 40, default: "Card"), ActionOption(name: "onPick", label: "Pick")],
      variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: Box(ariaLabel: "Card", onTap: RunAction(action: options.onPick, value: options.title), child: Text(child: options.title))),
        Variant(id: "big", label: "Big", build: Text(child: options.title, size: FontSize.xxl))])

componentSources.LoopB: Component(dsl: 1, id: "custom/loop-b", name: "LoopB", kind: Kind.section, description: "B", variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: LoopA())])
